exposure: transfersomal gel containing medroxyprogesterone acetate (FGT) with varying phosphatidylcholine:tween 80 concentrations
outcome: cumulative subcutaneous penetration of medroxyprogesterone acetate
cohort: The study involved the formulation and evaluation of transfersomal gels and a non-transfersomal gel containing medroxyprogesterone acetate.
finding: Transfersomal gel medroxyprogesterone acetate significantly increased cumulative transdermal penetration of medroxyprogesterone acetate by six times compared to non-transfersomal gel.
